description: Sync the recorded meetings and scorecard reviews an Avoma API key can see, with summaries and full transcripts.
opening: Sync the recorded meetings and scorecard reviews an Avoma API key can see. Each meeting is one document with its details, Avoma's AI summary and the transcript, each line labelled with its speaker. Each answered scorecard review is its own document, linked to the meeting it reviews.

Avoma permissions are not imported, so private meetings are visible to everyone who can query the collection unless you set an access rule. Changes are picked up only for a short time: 2 hours for meetings and 7 days for reviews. A transcript or summary that arrives after the 2-hour window is not picked up. Meetings deleted in Avoma can stay in HydraDB.

connect.text: Create the API key with Organization scope to sync everyone's meetings. A key's scope cannot be changed after it is created, and a key with a narrower scope syncs only the meetings that scope allows.

notes: Private meetings that only some Avoma users can see are synced like any other meeting when the key has Organization scope.

connect.auth: Avoma uses an API key. Only an Avoma admin can create one.

credentials.name: api_key
credentials.text: The whole Avoma API key exactly as issued: both parts, with the colon between them.

steps.title: Create an API key
steps.text: Have an Avoma admin create an API key with Organization scope.

steps.title: Create the connector
steps.text: Paste the whole key as `api_key`, including both parts and the colon.

steps.title: Select the organization
steps.text: HydraDB lists one item for all the meetings and reviews the key can see. Select it. You cannot pick individual meetings.

connect.account: One connector reads the meetings its API key's scope allows in one Avoma organization.

sync.first_sync: Reads meetings and reviews from the window set by `lookback_days`, 30 days by default.
sync.changes: Each sync reads meetings by start time and reviews by creation time. It reaches 2 hours back for meetings and 7 days back for reviews, to pick up recent changes.
sync.edits: Changes are picked up only inside those windows. A transcript or summary that arrives after the 2-hour window is not picked up. A review with no answers yet is skipped, and is picked up if it is answered within the 7 days. A change to a meeting does not update its reviews.
sync.deletes: Meetings and reviews deleted in Avoma can stay searchable in HydraDB.

shared_attributes.name: connector_id
shared_attributes.text: Limits a query to this connector's meetings and reviews. Not searchable.

documents.name: Meetings
documents.one_document: One meeting, with its summary and full transcript.
documents.title: The meeting subject, or `Avoma meeting <id>` when it has none.
documents.text: The title, then `Purpose`, `When`, `Organizer` and `Attendees` lines. Then Avoma's AI summary under `Summary`, and the transcript under `Transcript` as one `Speaker: text` line per segment. The title is searchable too.
documents.date: When the meeting started, else when it was created.
documents.link_back: The meeting in Avoma's web app.

attributes.name: summary
attributes.text: Avoma's AI summary, written under `Summary`.

attributes.name: purpose
attributes.text: The meeting's purpose or template label, written as the `Purpose` line.

attributes.name: organizer
attributes.text: The organizer's name or email, written as the `Organizer` line. The organizer is not attached to the meeting as a person in the graph.

attributes.name: attendees
attributes.text: Attendee names, written as the `Attendees` line. Attendees are not attached to the meeting as people in the graph.

attributes.name: start_at
attributes.text: When the meeting started, written as the `When` line. Sets the result date and decides which meetings each sync reads.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.avoma_meeting_id
attributes.text: The meeting's id. Picks out one meeting. The same key on scorecard reviews finds that meeting's reviews. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.recording_uuid
attributes.text: The recording's id. Picks out a meeting by its recording. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.organizer_email
attributes.text: The organizer's email. Limits a query to meetings one person organized. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.attendee_count
attributes.text: How many attendees the meeting had. Limits a query by meeting size. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.meeting_state
attributes.text: The meeting's state, such as `completed` or `scheduled`. Limits a query to completed meetings, for example. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.crm_object_ids
attributes.text: The ids of the CRM records linked to the meeting in Avoma. Finds the meetings linked to one opportunity or account. They do not link the meeting to items from a CRM connector. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.crm_object_types
attributes.text: The types of the linked CRM records. Limits a query to meetings linked to one kind of CRM record. Not searchable.

attributes.name: end_at
attributes.text: When the meeting ended.

attributes.name: duration
attributes.text: The recorded meeting length, in seconds.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.text: The meeting's outcome label.

attributes.name: meeting_type
attributes.text: Avoma's meeting type label.

attributes.name: processing_status
attributes.text: Whether the recording was still processing or complete when it was synced.

attributes.name: has_transcript
attributes.text: Whether the transcript was included.

attributes.name: is_call
attributes.text: Whether Avoma classed the meeting as a voice or video call.

attributes.name: is_internal
attributes.text: Whether Avoma classed the meeting as internal, meaning every attendee shares the organizer's domain.

documents.name: Scorecard reviews
documents.one_document: One scorecard review of one meeting. A review with no answers yet is skipped.
documents.title: The scorecard template name, or `Scorecard review` when it has none, followed by the meeting subject when there is one.
documents.text: The title, then `Meeting`, `Reviewed`, `Reviewer` and `Overall score` lines. Then each question in order, with its score, answer and reasoning. Avoma's citation markers are removed. The title is searchable too.
documents.date: When the review was created, else when the meeting started.

attributes.name: scorecard_name
attributes.text: The scorecard template's name, written in the title.

attributes.name: meeting_subject
attributes.text: The reviewed meeting's subject, written in the title and as the `Meeting` line.

attributes.name: scored_for
attributes.text: The person reviewed, written as the `Reviewed` line.

attributes.name: scored_by
attributes.text: The reviewer, written as the `Reviewer` line. For a review Avoma's AI wrote, this can be Avoma's AI email when there is no name.

attributes.name: overall_score
attributes.text: The overall score, written as the `Overall score` line.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.text: When the review was created. Sets the result date and decides which reviews each sync reads. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.avoma_meeting_id
attributes.text: The reviewed meeting's id. Fetches every review of one meeting, and links the review to that meeting. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.avoma_review_id
attributes.text: The review's id. Picks out one review. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.scorecard_id
attributes.text: The scorecard template's id. Limits a query to one scorecard. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.scored_for_email
attributes.text: The reviewed person's email. Finds every review of one person. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.scored_by_email
attributes.text: The reviewer's email, or `ai@avoma.com` for a review Avoma's AI wrote. Separates human and AI reviews. Not searchable.

attributes.name: reviewed_by_ai
attributes.text: Whether Avoma's AI wrote the review, worked out from the reviewer's email.

attributes.name: answer_count
attributes.text: How many answers the review returned. A question appears in the text only when it has question text.

example_searches: What did the customer say about budget on yesterday's discovery call?
How did Sam score on the SPICED scorecard for the Globex demo?
Summarize the last three calls with Acme.

connections: A scorecard review to the meeting it reviews.
No links to other tools. Linked CRM records are kept as ids for filtering only.
graph.people: The connector does not attach organizers, attendees, speakers or reviewers to items as people. Their names are part of the text.
graph.from_text: Each meeting's details, summary and transcript, and each review's text.

not_synced: Meetings outside the API key's scope.
A review's company name, deal names and modified time.
Changes after the 2-hour window for meetings or the 7-day window for reviews.
Deletions: meetings and reviews deleted in Avoma can stay in HydraDB.
